note: City of Carrollton campground beside Point Park, where the Kentucky River meets the Ohio; level concrete pads, playground, river walk, overlook and boat ramp nearby. Full tanks must be emptied at the dump station on arrival, not at the site. Winter campers must insulate their site's water hydrant (pipe wrap and heat tape). No generators. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the city's site and its reservationfriend engine: $40 Sun-Thu / $45 Fri-Sat (+6% sales and 4% room tax), $200/week, 10% military/AAA/ADA/senior, 33 full-hookup sites with 50A, back-in 1-14 & 21 and pull-through otherwise, dump, WiFi, open year-round, online booking, 15-day max Apr-Oct with long-term camping Nov-Mar. Not waterfront stands; pin is at the entrance ~100 m from the loops.
flags: BOOKING: stored had no platform; the city books online through reservationfriend.com (platform operator, url https://properties.reservationfriend.com/two-rivers-campground/Reservations). The engine's unit types include 'Motorhome Class C'.

LONG-TERM: the city sells long-term camping November-March ('Long term camping (November 1st - March 31st)') with a 15-day cap the rest of the year; nightly rates are posted year-round. A city park, so no long-stay drop question - noted for the reviewer.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. Imagery (400 m frame) shows the loops (~38.6779,-85.1859) on open ground with no water inside 100 m on any side; the engine says 'River' and markets a 'scenic river overlook' in Point Park, but no site is on either river.
